ambient_events: The bar fire ticks as it cools, then comes back on with a small thump.
Something in the yard settles, and a long way down the stack, something else answers.
The scales swing gently on their hook, weighing nothing, for no reason.
A page turns in the ledger. Nobody turned it.
description: A site shack raised on blocks, panelled in whatever was flattest that week and heated well past comfortable by a bar fire nobody is allowed to touch. The counter is a slab of scaffold board on two oil drums, worn pale in one spot where forty years of elbows have landed. Behind it: a wall of pigeonholes, each labelled in marker with a part name and a price that has been crossed out and rewritten at least twice. A set of hanging scales. A ledger, open, in handwriting that gets worse toward the bottom of every page. The window looks west over the yard. Out east to the gate.
name: Salvage Rites
